description: This Java class defines a validator for the ConceptSource object within the OpenMRS project. It ensures that the object has valid field values such as non-empty name and description, and checks the lengths of certain fields.

classes.name: ConceptSourceValidator
classes.description: A validator class that implements Spring's Validator interface to validate ConceptSource instances.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports converting a given class, specifically if it supports the ConceptSource class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the given object, throwing an IllegalArgumentException if the object is null or of an unsupported type, and applying validation rules to 'name' and 'description' fields.
